name: Extract Specter
body:
School necromancy [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 2, medium 2, occultist 2, shaman 2, spiritualist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one touched corpse
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Your touch extracts a specter from the corpse of a once-living corporeal creature. The created specter must have a number of Hit Dice equal to your caster level or lower, otherwise this spell fails. This specter obeys your commands to the best of its abilities. An individual corpse can only produce a specter once. Should that specter die, or when this spell ends, it cannot be extracted again.
